content: warren-be12 (#420): reap bookkeeping commits in src/runs/reap/stage.ts path-limit with 'git commit --only -- <pathspecs>' (.plot/ for plot state; the SEEDS_COMMITTABLE_FILES-derived .seeds/issues.jsonl + .seeds/plans.jsonl for seeds state) so pre-staged unrelated files in the workspace index are never swept into the chore(warren) commit. The seeds staged-delta guard (git diff --cached --quiet) is narrowed to the same two pathspecs for symmetry.

name: tighten structural dep interfaces to drop caller casts
description: When a structurally-typed dependency seam loosens a parameter to `unknown` (e.g. DispatchAutoPlanRunsInput.planRuns.create: (input: unknown) => ...), retype it to the real input type (CreatePlanRunInput from src/db/repos/plan-runs.ts) and delete the caller's `as unknown as` cast in pipeline.ts. It typechecks because the real PlanRunsRepo.create is structurally assignable: its richer CreatePlanRunResult return is assignable to the minimal { planRun: { id: string } } subset via return-type covariance, and identical params need no variance relaxation. Test fakes that still declare `input: unknown` keep compiling via parameter contravariance (unknown is a supertype of CreatePlanRunInput), so no fake rewrite is needed. Prefer import type to avoid any runtime import cycle into src/db/repos/.

content: Agents working in warren-on-warren must stage code with a scoped 'git add -- <pathspec>' and never 'git add -A' / 'git commit -a'. warren seeds .canopy/agent.json (a constitution-protected path) into the workspace with the effective provider/model; sweeping it into a commit flips the tracked builtin-agent envelope and blocks Article IX auto-merge (warren-aced). .seeds/issues.jsonl + .seeds/plans.jsonl are status bookkeeping that reap commits separately as 'chore(warren): seeds state'. The agent's PR should carry only its intended code diff; the prior cleanup-batch commits (#533-#541) all follow this two-commit shape.
